parts.text: My company does not want management or analytical reports, exports, and dashboards beyond day-to-day operations, or logging in through our own corporate identity systems. We also do not want several languages, any guarantee of meeting regulations, any compliance audit, data-retention or deletion features, backups, high availability, or spreading the service over several servers. We reject accounts and passwords inside the service, alerts to staff by e-mail, text message, or phone, software that plans routes or picks drones, and flying drones remotely through the service. Finally, we do not want weather information, billing or pricing of the work, or signing up new companies through the service. The relevant rules are the EU drone operation rules, including geographical zones and operator responsibilities, the EU U-space rules, including airspace information and flight authorisation, and the GDPR for personal data of staff.
